Class GameEngine

java.lang.Object
org.example.eiscuno.model.GameEngine
public class GameEngine extends Object
Core game engine implementing the rules of "Cincuentazo" (50-taZo).

    • playCard

      public void playCard(Player player, Card card) throws NoPlayableCardException
      Attempt to play a card for a player. For the human player the chosen card must be passed. For tests and CPU usage this API enforces the rule and updates deck/table/currentSum.
      Parameters:
      player - player performing the play
      card - card to play
      Throws:
      NoPlayableCardException - when the provided card cannot be played (or player has none playable)

    • checkEliminateIfNoPlay

      public boolean checkEliminateIfNoPlay(Player player)
      If a player's hand contains no playable card at the start of their turn, eliminate them. Eliminated player's cards are sent to the bottom of the deck.
